# Collins Dictionary

> > Comprehensive online dictionary and language reference from Collins, providing English definitions, pronunciations, synonyms, translations, and word game resources.

Collins Dictionary is a trusted language resource offering extensive lexicographic content including word definitions, usage examples, pronunciation guides, and synonym listings. The platform also supports language learners with multilingual translations and features tools for popular word games like Scrabble and Wordle.

## Key Topics

- Collins English Dictionary
- English definitions
- Word pronunciations
- Synonyms and thesaurus
- Language reference
- Lexicography
- Multilingual translations
- Scrabble word finder
- Wordle solver
- Word games
- Usage examples
- Collins lexicography
- Dictionary entries
- Language learning

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english): Main English dictionary with definitions, pronunciations, and synonyms
